say:1:1330919001:1.text: I know, the Archduke wanted the princess to rest without being disturbed.
say:1:1330919001:1.source_cn: 其实我也知道，这是大公希望公主殿下能够好好休息，早点恢复。
say:1:1330919001:1.male: I know, the Archduke wanted the princess to rest without being disturbed.
say:1:1330919001:1.female: I know, the Archduke wanted the princess to rest without being disturbed.

say:2:1330919002:1.text: But I'm afraid rest alone just isn't enough anymore. I hope we can find a skilled doctor soon...
say:2:1330919002:1.source_cn: 可殿下现在的情况，只依靠静养怕是很难恢复，希望能早点找...
say:2:1330919002:1.male: But I'm afraid rest alone just isn't enough anymore. I hope we can find a skilled doctor soon...
say:2:1330919002:1.female: But I'm afraid rest alone just isn't enough anymore. I hope we can find a skilled doctor soon...
